name: compare_web_captures
description: Compare passive web captures by providing before and after, or compare recorded scenarios by providing before_scenario and after_scenario with an optional normalization policy. Use exactly one input group. Scenario comparison aligns exact step IDs, records deterministic literal normalization, and returns every artifact-level difference plus alignment failures inline. Missing or truncated evidence never proves equality.
